title: Add --verbose and --debug flags to lab-vm
objective: Add --verbose (-v) and --debug (-d) flags to lab-vm for progressive verbosity. --verbose prints extra progress information (SSH commands, qemu args, genisoimage output). --debug prints everything including raw command output, timing, and internal state.

acceptance_criteria.text: lab-vm accepts --verbose (-v) and --debug (-d) flags at any position after the command
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Flag parsing in lab-vm (lines 194-235) iterates all args in any order; -v/--verbose sets VM_VERBOSE=1, -d/--debug sets VM_VERBOSE=1+VM_DEBUG=1. Same pattern in lab (lines 210-228, 232-267). Verified via --help text showing flags in usage section.

acceptance_criteria.text: Default (no flag): same output as today — status lines for each phase
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Default VM_VERBOSE=0, VM_DEBUG=0 (lines 53-54); log() prints unconditionally while log_verbose()/log_debug() gated. No behavioral change from prior version.

acceptance_criteria.text: --verbose: prints extra progress info (SSH commands, qemu virtiofsd output, genisoimage stdout/stderr, port discovery details)
acceptance_criteria.evidence: log_verbose() at line 63-65 prints [verbose] prefix when VM_VERBOSE>=1. Called throughout lifecycle.sh (SSH commands, port discovery) and prereqs.sh (distro/package info). Usage text at line 169 documents the flag.

acceptance_criteria.text: --debug: prints everything from --verbose plus raw command output, timing, and internal variable values
acceptance_criteria.evidence: log_debug() at line 67-69 prints [debug] timestamp prefix when VM_DEBUG>=1. -d/--debug sets both VM_VERBOSE=1 and VM_DEBUG=1 (line 203), so debug includes verbose. Usage text at line 170 documents the flag.
Usage text in lab-vm (lines 163-170) lists: -y/--yes, --auto-accept, --clean, -v/--verbose, -d/--debug, --unsafe-recurse, --base-size. lab (lines 525-536) lists: --verbose, --auto-accept.

acceptance_criteria.text: Verbose/debug flags are passed through to sourced library files via VM_VERBOSE/VM_DEBUG env vars
acceptance_criteria.evidence: export VM_VERBOSE VM_DEBUG at line 72. Library files (lifecycle.sh, prereqs.sh) check VM_VERBOSE/VM_DEBUG via log_verbose()/log_debug() helpers.

acceptance_criteria.text: lab-vm accepts -y/--yes flag that auto-accepts all interactive prompts (package install, confirmation summary), matching the LAB_YES=1 env var pattern
acceptance_criteria.evidence: lab-vm: -y/--yes/--auto-accept at line 200 sets VM_YES=1; prereqs.sh line 211 checks VM_YES before prompting; lifecycle.sh line 370 checks VM_YES for rebuild confirmation. lab: -y/--yes/--auto-accept at line 219 sets AUTO_ACCEPT=1+LAB_YES=1; confirm() at lines 169-172 checks LAB_YES, AUTO_ACCEPT, VM_YES.

acceptance_criteria.text: -y/--yes sets both VM_YES and LAB_YES env vars for cross-script compatibility
acceptance_criteria.evidence: lab-vm line 200: VM_YES=1; LAB_YES=1. lab line 219: AUTO_ACCEPT=1; LAB_YES=1. Both scripts init VM_YES from env at top (lab-vm line 51: VM_YES=${VM_YES:-${LAB_YES:-0}}, lab line 169 in confirm(): [[ "${VM_YES:-0}" == "1" ]]).
